Her musical style had more influence in the realm of jazz than in the realm of blues.

opts: Burckhardt’s discussion of women’s roles overemphasizes certain social and economic factors at the expense of other factors.
Burckhardt failed to conduct a detailed study of all of the works of Bruni.
